newEntry.name: Braid & Gather
newEntry.desc: Snip twenty runners, seat three radial legs between an indexed top and open foot, then arrange soft cords among eight loose braiding guides. Measured pierced-sheet/socket reference, adjustable passage and calibrated fits; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL top grips, connected-card and five-part STL/ZIP. Cord and six-socket adhesive required; no cord-clamping claim.
